title: Severity Shift Correlation
scenario: Calculate the correlation between the number of times a bug status changes and the eventual severity level.
tableSchema: bugs (bug_id INT, severity VARCHAR), status_history (bug_id INT, status VARCHAR)
hint: Count history entries per bug and group by severity.
correctQuery: SELECT severity, AVG(change_count) FROM (SELECT b.severity, b.bug_id, COUNT(sh.status) as change_count FROM bugs b JOIN status_history sh ON b.bug_id = sh.bug_id GROUP BY b.severity, b.bug_id) t GROUP BY severity;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE bugs (bug_id INT, severity VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE status_history (bug_id INT, status VARCHAR);
